title: Counselor Copilot student profile (draft v0.1, 2026-10-10)
label_logic_note: Only fields with role=can_move_label may change a reach/target/likely label. role=context_only fields are displayed beside the label. role=gate_only fields decide whether a label may be produced at all or how other inputs are interpreted.
never_collect: race/ethnicity or any proxy used in a decision (SFFA v. Harvard, 2023)
student name, address, date of birth, ID numbers, family income or SSN (FERPA / minors)

student_id.allowed: free text code, never a real name

applicant_type.note: international = needs a visa / schooled outside US system. Colleges often publish separate international admit rates (Lehigh CDS 2025-26 C1: 176 of 4182 admitted)

state_of_residence.if_missing: ask Q4; treat every public university as out-of-state and say so
state_of_residence.note: moves label for PUBLIC universities only; ignored for privates unless the college's CDS C1 shows a residency gap

gpa_value.if_missing: no GPA contribution; if school_type is not homeschool ask Q1

gpa_scale_max.allowed: integer 4..20 or 100 (the Common App dropdown options), or null for N/A
gpa_scale_max.if_missing: if gpa_value present and scale missing: STOP, ask Q1

gpa_weighted.if_missing: treat as weighted_unknown: GPA shown, never converted, cannot move label

grade_trend.note: shown as text; no public outcome data supports a numeric adjustment

class_rank.if_missing: omit; most schools do not rank and colleges rarely get it (Lehigh CDS C10: only 23.13% of enrollees had a rank)

rigor_level.if_missing: ask Q2; unknown = no rigor credit and no penalty
rigor_level.note: counselor judgement relative to what THIS school offers

advanced_courses_taken.allowed: AP + IB + dual-enrolment + honors-level count, grades 9-12 including planned senior year

advanced_courses_offered_by_school.allowed: count the school offers (from the school profile)
advanced_courses_offered_by_school.if_missing: null; then taken-count cannot be read as rigor

sat_superscore.allowed: true if value is max ERW + max Math across sittings

activities.if_missing: empty list: show 'no activity data'; never changes label
activities.note: no public dataset links activities to outcomes

intended_major.allowed: free text mapped to a program list
intended_major.if_missing: undecided; capacity-limited check skipped, and say so
intended_major.note: moves label only where the college publishes a school/major-specific rate (Illinois: Grainger Engineering 23.3% and CS 7.4% first-choice-major vs 38.1% overall)

major_capacity_limited_flag.if_missing: unknown (derived per college; not asked of the student)

first_generation.allowed: parents/guardians did not complete a 4-year degree (definitions vary; ask which)
first_generation.note: colleges rate it in CDS C7 but publish no admit-rate split

application_plan.note: CDS C21 gives ED applicants/admits at some colleges; pool is self-selected, so shown beside the label, not used to lift it

needs_financial_aid.note: never used to lower a label

essay_draft_text.if_missing: handled by the essay agent; never moves a label

activity_type.note: list per CollegeVine's copy of the Common App dropdown (secondary). For 2026-27 secondary sources say Work (Paid) became 'Employment or work (paid)' and Junior ROTC became 'ROTC and Military'. Not verified on commonapp.org.

position.note: optional from 2026-27 per secondary sources (not verified)

counselor_tier.note: 4-tier scheme published by CollegeVine; no outcome evidence found. Shown as the counselor's own label, never scored.

normalisation_rules: N1 VALIDATE FIRST. If gpa_value<0, or gpa_scale_max is set and gpa_value>gpa_scale_max, or sat_total is outside 400..1600 or not a multiple of 10, or act_composite is outside 1..36: set status=invalid_input, produce NO label, name the exact field and ask the counselor. Never clamp or silently fix (e.g. GPA 4.6 on a stated 4.0 scale).

N2 SCALE MUST BE KNOWN. If gpa_value is present and gpa_scale_max is null and gpa_value>4.0, ask Q1 (do not guess 5.0 or 100). If gpa_value<=4.0 and scale is unknown, accept as 'probably 4.0, unconfirmed' with confidence=low.

N3 GPA COMPARABILITY. Only gpa_weighted=false AND gpa_scale_max=4 is compared directly with college data (CDS C11 ranges on a 4.0 scale, C12 average). Weighted GPAs, 4.5/5.0/other scales and 100-point GPAs are NEVER converted by formula: no published universal conversion exists (not verified beyond the sources in the report). Display them as stated, set gpa_comparable=false, and keep GPA out of the label unless a school-supplied conversion or a counselor-recalculated core GPA (gpa_source) is entered.

N4 OPTIONAL RECALCULATION (UC method, if transcript grades are entered): use only A-G courses from the summer after grade 9 through the summer after grade 11; A=4,B=3,C=2,D=1,F=0, ignore plus/minus; add 1 point per semester of honors-level course (AP, IB HL, designated IB SL, UC-transferable college course, UC-certified honors) up to 8 semesters and at most 4 from 10th grade; divide total points by number of graded semester courses. For non-California residents honors weight is given to AP/IB only. CSU method differs: honors points for grades 10-12 up to 8 semesters, 10th-grade honors max 2.

N5 ACT TO SAT. Look up act_composite in sat_act_concordance.csv table A2_ACT_to_SAT: use sat_total_single_point as the value and carry [sat_range_low, sat_range_high] as the uncertainty band. Example: ACT 25 -> 1210, band 1200-1220. If both SAT and ACT exist, use the higher of sat_total and the concorded value, store both and say which was used. Only the composite is converted.

N6 SUPERSCORE. Only if per-sitting section scores are entered: superscore = max ERW + max Math across sittings and sat_superscore=true. Whether a given college superscores is not in CDS C7-C9: mark 'college policy not verified' and show both the best single sitting and the superscore.

N7 TEST POSITION. Compare the SAT-scale score with the college's published 25th/75th percentile (CDS C9 or College Scorecard): below_p25, p25_p50, p50_p75, above_p75. Never extrapolate outside the published range; if not published say so.

N8 NO SCORE. If test_status is not 'submitting': do not impute a score. Test-blind (University of California): the missing score has no effect; say so. Test-optional colleges: label from GPA and rigor only, confidence=low, and state that enrolled-student score ranges describe students who chose to submit. Test-required colleges (check policy per college and year): output 'incomplete: score required', no label.
N9 RIGOR. If advanced_courses_offered_by_school is known report 'took X of Y offered'; if not, never infer rigor from the raw count. rigor_level=unknown gives neither credit nor penalty.

N10 RESIDENCY. Public college and same state -> in-state pool; public and different state -> out-of-state pool; use CDS C1 residency counts if the college publishes them, otherwise say 'residency-specific rate not published', fall back to the overall rate and set confidence=low. Private colleges: overall rate unless C1 shows a gap.

N11 MAJOR. If intended_major is set and the college publishes a rate for that school or major, use it instead of the overall rate and cite it. If the major is probably capacity-limited and no major rate is available, never output 'likely'; show 'major-specific rate not available'.
N12 ACTIVITIES, FIRST-GEN, ED, ESSAY. Display only. They may add a sentence but must not change the label (no public applicant-level data links them to outcomes).
N13 PRIVACY. Strip name, address, date of birth and ID numbers from any pasted transcript before storing; keep nothing beyond the session unless the counselor explicitly saves it.

clarifying_questions.ask: Is the GPA weighted or unweighted, what is the scale (4.0, 5.0, 100-point, none), and is it through grade 11 or the school's final number?
clarifying_questions.reason: Weighted/unweighted and scale decide whether the GPA is comparable with a college's published GPA at all (N3). Common App also asks scale and weighted status separately.

clarifying_questions.ask: Relative to this school, is the course load the most demanding available, and how many AP/IB/dual-enrolment courses does the school offer versus how many the student took or plans for senior year?
clarifying_questions.reason: Colleges rate 'rigor of secondary school record' as its own factor (CDS C7) and judge it against what the school offers.

clarifying_questions.ask: Which test scores exist (SAT/ACT, which sittings), or is the student deliberately not submitting, and are test-required colleges on the list?
clarifying_questions.reason: A missing score means different things at test-blind, test-optional and test-required colleges (N8).

clarifying_questions.ask: What is the student's state of residence and citizenship or school system (US public, private, homeschool, international), and are public in-state colleges on the list?
clarifying_questions.reason: Public universities can publish very different in-state and out-of-state admit rates; international and homeschool applicants are read differently.

clarifying_questions.ask: For each college: what major is the student applying to, is it direct-admit or capacity-limited, and is the student applying early (ED/EA)?
clarifying_questions.reason: Major-specific rates can be several times lower than the overall rate; early rounds are reported separately in CDS C21.
